svg.aria-label: Map of Fiji with Taveuni enlargement locator and Rotuma inset
svg.metadata: Fiji coastlines: GSHHS/GSHHG via Basemap 2.0.0 (LGPL-3.0), WGS84 — main region at intermediate resolution drawn across the antimeridian to the canvas edge (including Taveuni, Qamea and the Lau islands), Taveuni and Rotuma insets at full resolution; redrawn 2026-10-28, replacing Apache Superset Fiji ADM1 supplements. Taveuni inset bounds start at 179.87°E so the whole island is shown; locator box and guide identify the enlarged area on the primary map. Sawa-i-Lau micro-island supplemented at map scale from verified island centre (OSM way 22570207 / GeoNames 2198469) and published dimensions (approximately 1.70 km by 1.15 km); Great Astrolabe Reef location outline is a reef symbol centred on GeoNames 2205206 and is not land. Three-region local-equirectangular layout. Checked 2026-10-28.
